node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 503): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,560.2 at t0; 500 levels a side; sizes, walls, stops, the own orders and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic; cost and clamp figures are a kit model, illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget. No real account identifier, key or balance. The session environment is drawn DEMO and LIVE as separate frames, each badge read from the session, never the feed (C-2.11); nothing on the board switches the environment.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark + light — this board is token-bound; it renders under dark and is exported twice: dark as docs/design/E21/img/E21-D03-05-trading-demo-live.png, light as docs/design/E21/img/E21-D03-05-trading-demo-live-light.png (the theme is switched at export; §0 L107: 3 light twins of 10 boards)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Frames 1280 × 800 windows; the dialog (CMP-043 lg) at comfortable density over SCR-050 at compact (§0)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: C-2.11: the badge reads the session environment, never the feed; DEMO and LIVE are separate frames

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Owner walkthrough item 6 (§18): could the LIVE confirm line be read as applying to DEMO

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L309 SCR-051/trading-demo: signal session environment demo; shows badge DEMO; W-18, W-19, presets, W-30; keyboard the badge is in the dialog's name (W-2); announced —; T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Badge DEMO from the session (R-4), in the dialog's name: "Heatmap + Ladder settings, BTCUSDT, DEMO"

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The two confirm rules are separate lines, never one toggle across environments: W-18 (LIVE, a CMP-005, on by default, T Sec) and W-19 (DEMO, a text line, PROPOSED: C-14, owner E30-D04 / E31); each applies to its own environment only

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Quantity presets 0.1 · 0.25 · 0.5 · 1 BTC (`14`:1241); W-30 read-only with Ctrl+Shift+T; prefs only — nothing here places, amends or cancels an order (E21 has no order path)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L310 SCR-051/trading-live: signal session environment live; shows badge LIVE; the same lines; keyboard as demo; announced —; T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Badge LIVE from the session (R-4): "Heatmap + Ladder settings, BTCUSDT, LIVE"; the same lines as DEMO

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The environment is switched by SCR-074 / SCR-075 (`14`:81), never here; switching to LIVE takes C-2.11's typed confirm

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L311 SCR-051/live-confirm-off: signal W-18 unchecked; shows W-20 in a CMP-028 warning; keyboard focus stays on the checkbox; announced W-20 polite once (R-5); T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: W-18 unchecked in a LIVE session: W-20 in a CMP-028 warning inline under it, no modal; re-checking removes it; focus stays on the checkbox

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: No step-up to turn it off: PROPOSED, the inline warning only (C-14; owner E30-D04 / E31); no frame shows the warning under a DEMO badge
